results.title: Activists accuse Mumbai cops of pressuring people, raiding venues to stop Umar Khalid film screening
results.description: In a concerning turn of events, activists claim that the Mumbai police halted a screening of the documentary centered on Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam, allegedly resorting to intimidation tactics at both the original venue and a backup location. The film, titled 'Prisoner No. 626710 Is Present', sheds light on Khalid’s imprisonment.
